scientific.claim: For the quaternary \([21,4,11]\) code \(C_2\) displayed in Example 2.1 of Kawamoto, Kato, and Maruta, let \(m_C(H)\) be the number of generator-matrix columns lying in a projective plane \(H\subset \mathrm{PG}(3,4)\), counted with multiplicity, let \(E=\{H:m_C(H)\equiv0\pmod4\}\), and for a projective point \(P\) set \(e(P)=|\{H\in E:P\in H\}|\). Across the 85 points of \(\mathrm{PG}(3,4)\), the exact distribution is \(N_0=2,N_1=1,N_2=16,N_3=9,N_4=25,N_5=23,N_6=2,N_7=7\), where \(N_j=|\{P:e(P)=j\}|\). Consequently the exhibited point \(P=(0,0,1,3)\) is the unique 1-locally 3-weight center modulo 4 for this code, and exactly 16 projective points are 2-locally 3-weight centers modulo 4.
scientific.integrity: All finite counts were recomputed from the displayed generator and checked against the source plane spectrum before the local-depth census.
scientific.limitations: Exact only for the generator matrix printed in Example 2.1; no classification of all [21,4,11] codes is claimed.

title: Local three-weight depth census for the quaternary \([21,4,11]\) example
